source.title: Goethe-Zertifikat B1 Wortliste
source.note: A B1-list collision is a strong replacement signal for Artikelwerk Normal. Example or category attestation is recorded separately from an explicit lexical entry and is not misrepresented as exact list membership.

chemie.reason: Goethe B1 lists Chemie among school subjects; it is below the intended Normal floor.

mathe.reason: Goethe B1 explicitly lists Mathe(matik) among school subjects.

mathematik.reason: Goethe B1 explicitly covers Mathe(matik); a Level 2 Normal slot is not justified.

philosophie.reason: Goethe B1 lists Philosophie among school subjects.

physik.reason: Goethe B1 lists Physik among school subjects.

software.reason: Goethe B1 explicitly lists Software in its Anglicismen group.

gramm.reason: Goethe B1 explicitly teaches Gramm in its measures and weights group.

killer.reason: Goethe B1 explicitly lists Killer/Killerin among Anglicisms; Advanced C1 placement is indefensible.

demokratie.reason: Goethe B1 explicitly lists Demokratie under political concepts.

parlament.reason: Goethe B1 explicitly lists Parlament under political concepts.

akademie.reason: Goethe B1 includes Akademie among Austrian education institutions.

grieche.reason: Goethe B1 explicitly lists der Grieche in the nationality group.

krokodil.reason: Goethe B1 explicitly lists das Krokodil in its animal vocabulary.

sosse.reason: Goethe B1 explicitly lists die Soße/Sauce; it is far below the Normal floor.

dritter.reason: Goethe B1 covers ordinal forms including dritte; the stored Dritter entry is also morphologically unsuitable for this quiz.

vollmond.reason: Vollmond appears naturally in Goethe B1 example material and offers insufficient Normal value.

jahreszeit.reason: Jahreszeit is used repeatedly in Goethe B1 example material and belongs below the Normal floor.

rueckseite.reason: Rückseite appears in ordinary Goethe B1 usage material and is too basic for the Normal allocation.

uhrzeit.reason: Uhrzeit is an explicit Goethe B1 time-vocabulary domain and does not merit a Normal slot.

republik.reason: Republik appears directly in Goethe B1 political/country vocabulary; keep harder institutional vocabulary instead.

kontinent.reason: Kontinent is part of the Goethe B1 countries/continents domain and is too basic for this Normal slot.
